benssharks_tick_listeners.conversion: At the end of common setup (bons.furious.patch.benssharks.SetupHook -> SharksSetup) Ben's 62 LivingTickEvent and 6 LevelTickEvent listeners are taken off the Forge bus; injectors at the head of each Ben's entity's baseTick run the original handlers whose guard can accept it (Dispatch, Table), Dolphin.tick runs DolphinEatSardine, a Bleeding pass runs the two Bleeding handlers for bleeding entities only, and one LevelTickEvent listener runs SmoothTurns / SeekingHandler over sets fed by ServerLevel.EntityCallbacks. Formerly part of the separate mod Bons Sharks Fix 1.0.0.
benssharks_tick_listeners.license: LGPL-3.0 (Ben's Sharks): the mixins hold only our own code and call Ben's original methods unchanged; the dispatch table names Ben's classes, fields and methods only
